Inherited deficiency of vitamin K-dependent coagulation factors. Joint and intracranial hemorrhage and skeletal abnormalities occur below 30%.

Inherited cardiac repolarization disorder causing prolonged QT and ventricular arrhythmias; syncope does not establish neurologic damage.
